title: Chapter 372 Enemy?
content:
Chapter 372 Enemy?

"Hey, brother, what level has your base been upgraded to?"

A warrior holding a broadsword in the distance came over with a group of sword and shield warriors.

It can be seen that he prefers this kind of heavily armed warrior.

Comparatively speaking, the advantage of cavalry is not obvious for a single warrior, or even a warrior.

But Wang Shuo's earth dragon beast can increase the strength of the warrior himself, and even without charging, the combat power is also increased.

"Hehe, brother, what about you!?"

Wang Shuo did not answer directly, after all, the two were not familiar with each other.

"As for me, I just upgraded to level 2. It was too difficult in the early stage. I was about to vomit when I killed the earth mother worm alone."

This warrior named Huang Qiang seemed to have no other thoughts.

I don't know if he was disguised too well or his mind was simple.

After seeing that Wang Shuo had summoned a warrior, he exclaimed.

"Brother, you can do it. You have a good chance to challenge the position of commander in the competition the day after tomorrow."

"When the time comes, don't forget me, brother!"

"Haha, definitely."

Wang Shuo saw that behind him, there were only 10 sword and shield soldiers composed of junior generals.

Thinking in his heart, I am afraid this is the normal start mode!

Wang Shuo must now play another Shura Order and then summon the general.

To upgrade to level 4, 80 Shura Orders are required.

It is not something that can be done in a short time.

To improve strength, you must accumulate more merit points and exchange some other props.

After parting with Huang Qiang, Wang Shuo wanted to continue to clear the nearby earth mother insects, but there were no more around.

Wang Shuo had to go further.

He didn't have a map of this area now.

If he went deep rashly, if he entered the enemy's lair, it would be like a birthday man hanging himself, and he thought his life was too long.

So, every time he walked a distance, Wang Shuo was cautious.

What he needed now was to kill a large number of low-level earth mother insects and gain merit. As for higher-level warriors, it would be better if they could be found, but it didn't matter if they couldn't. Anyway, the number of Shura Orders needed for upgrading could not be gathered in a short time.

Soon, Wang Shuo found a nest of earth mother insects on a hilltop.

Through observation, this nest was much larger than those encountered before.

"Be careful."

Wang Shuo decided to send Zhu Tianguo to lead the earth mother insects out of the nest, and then he and others would ambush outside and kill them one by one.

This is not only efficient, but also safe.

Wang Shuo didn't want the warriors he summoned to be damaged in the process of slaying monsters.

After a while, Zhu Tianguo came running with dozens of earth mother insects.

Wang Shuo was delighted and immediately called his men to work.

The highest level of this batch of earth mother insects was only the gold boss, and everyone killed it effortlessly.

At this time, Wang Shuo heard the sound of fighting from the nest, as well as the screams of the earth mother insect boss.

Wang Shuo was puzzled, could someone go deep into the nest?

"Tianguo, did you see anyone else just now?"

"My Lord, no!" Zhu Tianguo thought for a moment and shook his head.

"Let's go in and take a look."

Wang Shuo took the lead in entering the nest, and following the sound of fighting, he soon came to a hall in the nest.

At this time, a dark gold boss earth mother worm was fighting with a group of people.

Wang Shuo found that these people were very different from himself, mainly because they had a red dart mark on their foreheads.

And he and others had purple dart marks on their heads.

Enemy?
